verdict.rationale: Baseten clearly supports uploading/serving custom or fine-tuned model weights via Truss (config.yaml specifying model/hardware/engine, custom Docker/Python server, deploy any synced checkpoint) and training produces checkpoints deployable to production endpoints. However, no evidence explicitly addresses LoRA adapter upload/serving (e.g., multi-adapter serving, adapter merging, or adapter-specific endpoints). Missing for 10: explicit LoRA adapter support/serving documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of custom weight uploads beyond first-party docs.
